name: Port Peril Bar Fight (Rivanti's Bar) (1-2) OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Quest #4: Port Peril Pub Crawl

stealth.note: -10 and no minimum proficiency to notice

description: An assorted crowd throws punches, flings bottles, and otherwise flies into chaos as a bar fight breaks out, clustering in six sections of one of Port Peril's drinking houses.
disable: DC 17 Intimidation to cow a section of crowd or DC 20 Diplomacy to attempt to disperse it
routine: (2 actions) The bar fight uses its first action to make a general mayhem Strike against all creatures in any area that has not been disabled. Make one Strike against each enemy in the area and roll the damage only once for all targets. The bar fight then uses its second action to use Port Peril specialty.

generalAbilities.name: Port Peril Specialty
generalAbilities.description: The bar fight creates an effect unique to the bar, located at any point within the hazard (even within sections that have been disabled) as long as the entire hazard has not been disabled. The DC for each effect is 15.

generalAbilities.name: Jinx Gone Wrong
generalAbilities.description: Something about the bar fight has attracted a storm of bad luck, causing a character to bang their shin on a pushed-out bench or get hit on the head by a falling painting. The hazard casts Jealous Hex on a creature. This effect is a Rivanti's Bar specialty.
